summary: Well-crafted PowerShell code with proper Set-StrictMode, error handling, parameter validation, and -LiteralPath usage. Workflow correctly uses shell: pwsh and least-privilege permissions. Minor gaps: workflow lacks actionlint validation step (required per task), commit log parsing could guard malformed separators better. Module functions are focused and testable. Clean naming and helpful comments throughout, though commit classification regex (line ~105) could use 1-line explanation. Production-ready with small refinements possible.
